allocation_scope: Fresh whole process, successful glibc-interposed requested bytes/calls, USE_ZEND_ALLOC=0 and diagnostic RTLD_DEEPBIND removal; includes startup, compilation, warmup and measured jobs. Not live heap and not primary timing.
canonical_comparison_scope: Shared App Definition/native generic subset: no floats, arrays <=512 members, depth <32; generated maps have <=256 members. No claim of a PHP baseline for the entire generic profile.
capacity_scope: Backlogged burst and closed-loop saturation, synthetic deterministic owner-derived workload. No production arrival-rate or HTTP capacity claim.
